findings.description: New IssueStatus "blocked" is selectable when creating an issue and as part of the IssueStatus type system. CreateIssue now offers backlog, todo, in_progress, blocked, done.
findings.before: IssueStatus was "backlog" | "todo" | "in_progress" | "done" | "cancelled" without "blocked"; CreateIssue STATUSES did not include blocked.
findings.after: IssueStatus includes "blocked" and CreateIssue STATUSES is ["backlog","todo","in_progress","blocked","done"] allowing users to create blocked issues.
findings.confidenceReason: Patch directly adds "blocked" to type union and to CreateIssue status array with explicit excerpts.
uncertainties: No explicit button label or form submission flow text shown in patch; selection control UI not detailed.

findings.description: IssueDetail status selector now includes "blocked" alongside existing statuses, allowing users to change an existing issue to Blocked (now 6 options including cancelled).
findings.after: IssueDetail STATUSES is ["backlog","todo","in_progress","blocked","done","cancelled"] with blocked available during editing.
findings.confidenceReason: Patch explicitly inserts "blocked" into IssueDetail STATUSES array.

findings.description: Issue list groups and sorts issues with new Blocked tier positioned second after In Progress, before Todo/Backlog/Done/Cancelled, and server listIssues supports filtering by blocked.
findings.before: Client STATUS_ORDER was ["in_progress","todo","backlog","done","cancelled"] and server filter description listed todo,in_progress,done,backlog,cancelled with ORDER BY ranking without blocked.
findings.after: Client STATUS_ORDER is ["in_progress","blocked","todo","backlog","done","cancelled"] and server status query description adds blocked and ORDER BY assigns WHEN 'blocked' THEN 1 pushing todo to 2 etc.
findings.confidenceReason: Both client STATUS_ORDER patch and server OpenAPI description plus SQL CASE ordering explicitly show blocked insertion.

findings.description: StatusIcon renders distinct Blocked indicator: red #dc2626 circle with horizontal line, label "Blocked" via STATUS_LABELS[status] aria-label.
findings.before: STATUS_COLORS and STATUS_LABELS had no blocked entry and StatusIcon had no blocked branch; only done/cancelled etc handled.
findings.after: STATUS_COLORS blocked is "#dc2626", STATUS_LABELS blocked is "Blocked", and StatusIcon returns dedicated SVG with circle and horizontal line for status === "blocked".
findings.confidenceReason: Patch adds color, label entries and explicit blocked render branch with exact SVG.

uncertainties: Runtime persistence, validation, migration of existing issues to blocked, and exact visible control type (dropdown/radio) not shown in patches.
Supplied patches may be incomplete per notice; additional UI text or documentation changes could exist outside selected context.
